publish: POST /api/_broadcast/publish    { slug, sdp }       - server-proxied SDP exchange
subscribe: POST /api/_broadcast/subscribe  { slug, sdp }       - pull tracks from a live publisher
stop: POST /api/_broadcast/stop       { slug }            - tear down the slug → frees viewers
heartbeat: POST /api/_broadcast/heartbeat  { slug }            - keep a live slug claimed (bm.broadcast.publish sends it every minute)
